payload.claim: Proton VPN passed a fifth consecutive annual Securitum no-logs audit in 2026
payload.quote: The 2026 review marks the fifth consecutive annual no-logs audit conducted by Securitum since Proton began publishing independent assessments of its VPN infrastructure.

payload.claim: The 2026 Proton audit covered both free and paid servers
payload.quote: According to the audit report, Securitum examined selected production VPN servers from both Proton’s free and paid offerings, as well as VPN configuration files, deployment mechanisms, internal documentation, and operational procedures.

payload.claim: The 2026 Proton audit sampled only free-tier servers
payload.quote: The 2026 Securitum engagement sampled only servers from Proton's free tier, so the paid Plus servers that subscribers actually use were not part of the review.

payload.claim: Proton VPN unblocked 10 of 14 streaming services with 10.2% average speed loss
payload.quote: It unblocked 10 of the 14 services, including Netflix in the US, Canada, and Japan on standard servers, BBC iPlayer, Prime Video, Peacock, and JioHotstar.

payload.claim: Proton VPN Plus costs under 3 dollars a month on a two-year term
payload.quote: On a two-year term, the VPN Plus plan costs under $3 a month and covers 10 devices.

payload.claim: NordVPN unblocked all 14 streaming services tested
payload.quote: NordVPN unblocked all 14 services we tried, a result only ExpressVPN matched.

payload.claim: NordVPN has had six independent audits since 2018
payload.quote: Six independent audits since 2018 back its no-log policy.

payload.claim: NordVPN Basic two-year plan is under 3.50 a month
payload.quote: The Basic plan is under $3.50 a month on a two-year term.

payload.claim: NordVPN cheapest two-year Basic plan costs 5.99 a month after a 2026 pricing overhaul
payload.quote: Following its 2026 pricing overhaul, NordVPN's cheapest two-year Basic plan now works out to $5.99 a month, and month-to-month billing is about $15.

payload.claim: Surfshark no-log policy audited by Deloitte in 2023 and 2025
payload.quote: Camouflage Mode disguises VPN traffic on restrictive networks, CleanWeb strips ads from streaming sites, and Deloitte audited the no-log policy in 2023 and 2025.

payload.claim: Surfshark unblocked 13 of 14 services with 9.6% average speed loss
payload.quote: Surfshark unblocked 13 of the 14 services, including Hulu and JioHotstar, and it required no browser extension for any of them.

payload.claim: Surfshark Starter costs about 2.50 a month on a 27-month term
payload.quote: On a 27-month term, the Starter plan costs about $2.50 a month, and Surfshark’s One plan adds antivirus for a little more.

payload.claim: ExpressVPN no-log policy is independently audited
payload.quote: Its no-log policy is independently audited, and the Basic plan costs under $3 a month on a 28-month term.

payload.claim: ExpressVPN unblocked all 14 services with 7.8% average speed loss
payload.quote: ExpressVPN also unblocked all 14 services, with the same 7.8% average speed loss as NordVPN.

payload.claim: PrivadoVPN completed its first independent no-logs audit in early 2026
payload.quote: That changed when it completed its first independent no-logs audit in early 2026, a review of its server infrastructure and apps that found no logging of browsing activity, DNS queries or connection metadata.

payload.claim: PrivadoVPN was almost as fast as NordVPN and Surfshark and unblocked streaming
payload.quote: When reviewing it, PrivadoVPN was almost as fast as NordVPN and Surfshark – two of the fastest VPNs.

payload.claim: PrivadoVPN two-year plan is 30 dollars total, about 1.11 a month
payload.quote: The two-year plan costs $30 in total, roughly $1.11 a month, and the one-year plan is $20.

payload.claim: Mullvad charges a flat rate regardless of plan length, about 5.50
payload.quote: Mullvad is the one exception to the pattern, since it charges a flat rate regardless of length.

payload.claim: Comparitech Q3 2026 speed tests ranked Mullvad, NordVPN and ExpressVPN fastest
payload.quote: Mullvad VPN, NordVPN, and ExpressVPN were the fastest providers this quarter.

payload.claim: IPVanish completed a third Schellman no-logs audit on 25 Sept 2026
payload.quote: The audit was completed by Schellman Compliance, a leading provider of attestation services, on September 25, 2026.

payload.claim: DuckDuckGo VPN lacks streaming-optimized servers and costs 9.99 a month
payload.quote: It lacks multi-hop routing, split tunneling, dedicated IP addresses, and streaming-optimized servers, all of which are common in VPNs like NordVPN or Surfshark.
